verdict.rationale: Viam documents generic ML model training/deployment ('bring your own model', push trained models to cloud for local inference) and a motion-planning service that could host custom control logic, which together could support integrating a VLA or robotics foundation model — but no evidence specifically mentions VLA, foundation models, or dedicated tooling/integrations for such models. Missing for 10: explicit VLA/foundation-model support, documented integration examples, prebuilt model-hub connectors, or partner/third-party corroboration of foundation-model deployment on Viam.
